title: aethionema saxatile subsp. gracile
intro: Aethionema saxatile subsp. gracile, commonly known as Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Rock Jasmine include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
